Audit Finding: One sampled provisioning record lacked complete manager approval evidence
Management Response: Management agrees that approval evidence should be retained consistently
Corrective Action: Update provisioning workflow to require documented manager approval before account creation
Validation Evidence: Updated access request workflow and approval records

Audit Finding: Two terminated users retained access beyond the expected disablement timeframe
Management Response: Management agrees that termination processing requires stronger coordination with HR
Corrective Action: Automate HR termination notifications and monitor account disablement completion
Validation Evidence: Termination workflow configuration and disablement logs

Audit Finding: Three privileged accounts lacked current business justification or recent review evidence
Management Response: Management agrees to strengthen privileged-access governance
Corrective Action: Perform quarterly privileged-access reviews and require documented business justification
Validation Evidence: Privileged account inventory and review approvals

Audit Finding: Two privileged accounts lacked MFA and approved exceptions
Management Response: Management agrees MFA should be enforced consistently
Corrective Action: Enable MFA for all applicable privileged accounts and formally document exceptions
Validation Evidence: MFA enrollment report and exception records

Audit Finding: Two access-review findings lacked evidence showing unnecessary access was removed
Management Response: Management agrees remediation evidence should be retained for every access-review exception
Corrective Action: Add mandatory closure evidence to the access-review process
Validation Evidence: Access review records and access-removal evidence

Audit Finding: One production change lacked complete testing evidence
Management Response: Management agrees change testing documentation should be strengthened
Corrective Action: Require test evidence before final approval and implementation
Validation Evidence: Updated change workflow and sample change tickets

Audit Finding: Two review periods lacked sufficient documentation showing security logs were analyzed
Management Response: Management agrees the review process requires more consistent documentation
Corrective Action: Establish recurring log-review records with reviewer findings and escalation details
Validation Evidence: SIEM review reports and investigation tickets

Audit Finding: Three high-risk vulnerabilities exceeded remediation timelines without documented risk acceptance
Management Response: Management agrees overdue findings should require stronger governance
Corrective Action: Enforce remediation SLAs and require formal approval for overdue high-risk vulnerabilities
Validation Evidence: Vulnerability aging report remediation tickets and risk acceptance records

Audit Finding: One incident lacked complete escalation and closure documentation
Management Response: Management agrees incident records should be standardized
Corrective Action: Implement an incident closure checklist covering escalation evidence actions and lessons learned
Validation Evidence: Updated incident template and completed incident records

Audit Finding: No current tabletop exercise was available
Management Response: Management agrees that response procedures should be tested regularly
Corrective Action: Schedule and conduct an annual tabletop exercise with documented lessons learned and corrective actions
Validation Evidence: Tabletop exercise report participant list and action tracker

Audit Finding: Only two recent restoration tests had sufficient evidence
Management Response: Management agrees restoration testing should be performed and documented consistently
Corrective Action: Establish quarterly recovery testing and retain test results
Validation Evidence: Restore test reports and recovery logs

Audit Finding: Two high-risk vendors had outdated reassessment evidence
Management Response: Management agrees high-risk vendors require recurring review
Corrective Action: Create an annual reassessment schedule and escalate overdue high-risk vendor reviews
Validation Evidence: Vendor reassessment records and remediation tracker

Audit Finding: One sampled policy exceeded its scheduled review date
Management Response: Management agrees the policy review schedule should be monitored
Corrective Action: Update the overdue policy and implement automated review reminders
Validation Evidence: Updated policy approval and review record

Audit Finding: Two open risks lacked complete treatment or approval documentation
Management Response: Management agrees that risk records should include complete ownership and treatment decisions
Corrective Action: Require owners target dates treatment decisions and approval for all material risks
Validation Evidence: Updated risk register and approval records

Audit Finding: Two prior findings were closed without sufficient validation evidence
Management Response: Management agrees audit findings should not close until remediation is independently validated
Corrective Action: Require validation evidence and formal closure approval before changing findings to Closed
Validation Evidence: Updated finding tracker validation evidence and closure approvals
